rule: PASS opens. BLOCKED opens only when `## Verification` lists its open BLOCKING findings or the blocked layer and why; merging needs PASS.

rule: Claude never launches Codex

proof: setup refuses a secondary checkout unless DOT_AGENT_ALLOW_SECONDARY_SOURCE=1

No code comments

rule: Retired names and old vocabulary stay out of active files

notes: replaces guardrails.tsv

proof: the install job fails when setup or verify-profile fails

rule: Agents never push to main or master in Claude Code, by name, by HEAD or @ or a bare push with main checked out, or with --all, --branches or --mirror, including through the Terminal tool
notes: PreToolUse deny on git push to main or master, through shells, wrappers, command substitution and heredocs fed to a shell; fails open if the script is missing; a guard against accidents, not obfuscation; merging a PR follows pause-merge and merge-gate; a push that lands on main only through git config (push.default, remote.origin.push) is not seen

rule: No commits on main or master in this repo
notes: setup sets core.hooksPath

rule: Each commit runs the static checks
render Mermaid inline with the `show_widget` tool by copying `~/.dot-agent/docs/diagrams/mermaid-widget.html` and replacing only SUMMARY and SOURCE.

rule: Every committed Mermaid diagram keeps within scripts/diagram-lint.py: at most 8 boxes, labels of at most 8 words, color only through class done, todo or problem, and no classDef, style, linkStyle, hex colors, init directives or C4 types
notes: scripts/check runs diagram-lint.py --repo over committed .mmd files and Markdown mermaid fences; proof: the README loop diagram before 2.15.0 (11 boxes, labels up to 15 words) fails; chat diagrams are held to it by the mermaid-style rule and AGENTS.md, and agents can run it on a source before sending

rule: Ask the owner first, even under "run until done":
notes: kept: the header of the pause list; each item below is its own row

rule: merging a high-risk PR
notes: merge-risk classifies; merge-gate denies a high-risk merge without the owner's recorded approval and every merge outside gh pr merge; their words are recorded by the agent, so this stops accidents, not a dishonest agent

rule: deploying, publishing or making anything public;
notes: kept: judgment; the Artifact publish step and permission prompts already stop it

rule: deleting data or history: force-pushing a shared branch, deleting another session's branch or worktree, deleting uncommitted files, or deleting Tasks or Calendar events;

rule: sending an email, message, comment or invite as the owner
notes: PreToolUse ask on any MCP send, reply, forward, post, invite, event change or share; a hook, not a permissions rule, because connector server names differ per account; no past incident, promoted by the 2.4.0 audit; Codex is not covered

rule: money, credentials, or account and security settings;
notes: kept: judgment, backed by the runtime's own safety rules

rule: writing private data: no mode or skill grants that authority;
notes: kept: judgment

rule: closing a commitment: agent-reported success never does; only the owner's explicit completion statement authorizes that exact update.
notes: kept: judgment

rule: The owner approving a `~/.dot-agent` merge also approves updating this Mac right after
notes: kept: an authority statement, not a checkable act

rule: Completed, verified topic-branch work ships: commit, push and open/update the PR without another permission round.
notes: kept: judgment about when work is done

rule: Codex is paused: run no Codex model until the owner restores it

rule: Never silently substitute a model.
notes: kept: honest reporting is judgment; the locks stop the switch itself

rule: Work sync and executable harness updates are separate operations
notes: kept: judgment about which operation runs

rule: A repo made from template/apply.sh gets the 9-file skeleton without losing a file it had, and passes its own scripts/check

rule: A repo made from the template carries the 9-file skeleton

notes: scripts/check runs it on dot-agent

rule: A PR is reported as one line with link text repo#N, version, short title — what it does, checks, verdict, risk and needs, in that order, grouped under Needs you, Running and Done

rule: parallel-plan names every lane in plain words, the same in the diagram and the table
proof: fails on a letter or code lane name or a one-word lane in the example table

rule: A merge runs only through gh pr merge, and only when the PR's checks are all green, its head has a PASS verdict with no open BLOCKING finding, --match-head-commit pins that head, and a high-risk PR carries the owner's approval recorded for that head; a merge through gh api, GraphQL, curl or an MCP merge tool is denied; the gate also reads Terminal commands and denies arming auto-merge through the app's tool
notes: PreToolUse deny in Claude Code; fails closed when gh cannot read the PR, its checks or its changed files, or its no-push-to-main.py helper is missing, open if merge-gate.py itself is missing; branch protection is unavailable on this plan; proof for the API half: the 297314a fix lived in ask-before-merge.py and was lost in the 2.2.0 rewrite; does not cover the web UI or Codex

rule: A PR is high risk when it touches setup or install, hooks, CI or the merge gate, AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, CONSTRAINTS.tsv, model locks, private data, money or credentials, or outside actions, deletes a file, or has a dismissed BLOCKING finding
notes: path patterns in HIGH_RISK, including every file setup.sh runs, sources or imports (profiles/*/ensure.sh, toml_compat.py), found by following setup.sh, and profiles/*/provided-skills (proof: profiles/work/ensure.sh was low risk in verdict f4b17f6); AGENTS.md and this row name every HIGH_RISK category; verdict.py risk prints the tier for the PR body; the merge gate reads changed files from gh

rule: A verdict is PASS only when the review layer passed, so every PR gets an independent review
notes: risk sets quick or deep review in the verify skill L4

rule: Each review finding is logged with the verdict: BLOCKING or NOTE, a kind, file:line evidence and an outcome, with a reason when dismissed; an open BLOCKING finding makes the verdict BLOCKED
notes: a finding may name its cause (missing context, unmapped case, bad data, agent wrong); a dismissal needs a reason and a cause

rule: verdict.py kinds names every finding kind seen at least twice so it becomes a lint rule or CONSTRAINTS.tsv row
notes: the verify skill L4 says to run it when closing a review; kinds --by-cause counts misses by cause; no scheduled job reads either since 2.11.0

rule: Rounds: one review, then one re-check that reads only the fix's diff.
notes: kept: judgment about review effort; verdict.py could count rounds if it recurs

rule: Merges are counted as auto, owner-approved or outside the gate from gh and the verdict log
notes: for the weekly report: scripts/merge-stats.py <owner/repo>... --days 7

rule: A template repo's scripts/check fails on a tracked Python, shell or JSON file that does not parse
notes: shallow on purpose; CI runs it, no pre-commit hook is shipped

rule: A verdict records only with live and review evidence and with carried evidence from a commit whose tree equals HEAD
A PR's VERSION is not already used by VERSION or a RELEASES.md heading on its base or origin/main, and RELEASES.md names it once

notes: --force, -f, --force-with-lease and +refspecs; each chat works in its own worktree, so another chat's branch is never the one checked out here; reconstructed, not a logged incident

notes: a reworded sentence (60% similar to one to four adjacent sentences) counts as kept; proof: the PR 290 AGENTS.md trim before its 297314a repair
